sources.entry: Consensus - AI-powered research engine that finds and summarizes scientific papers. #freemium

summary.name: Consensus
summary.one_liner: Consensus is an AI academic search engine that searches and analyzes peer-reviewed research papers.
use_cases: Checking whether research agrees on a yes-or-no question
Finding high-quality clinical or medical evidence
Filtering papers by timeframe, population, or study design
Exploring conflicting arguments in the literature
summary.what_it_does: Consensus searches a database the page describes as 250M+ research papers, including licensed full text from publishers. Its Deep Search feature builds a search strategy by expanding key terms, identifying conflicting arguments, and exploring the citation graph. A Medical mode narrows results to about 50,000 clinical guidelines and 8M articles from the top 1,000 medical journals. Users can specify timeframes, populations, and study designs in natural-language prompts, and the tool applies filters automatically. For clear yes-or-no questions, the Consensus Meter shows how much the evidence agrees or disagrees.
notable: Consensus Meter visualizes evidence agreement for yes-or-no research questions
Deep Search automates literature review strategy and citation graph exploration
Medical mode limits results to clinical guidelines and top medical journals
Natural-language prompts automatically apply search filters
caveats: Page does not state which features are paid versus free; freemium is taken from the listing
Access through over 170 university libraries is noted, which may depend on institutional partnership
